resumeText:
Priya Nair | Bengaluru | priya.nair@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Lead Frontend Engineer, Nilgiri Retail Tech, Bengaluru (2018 - present)

- Review pull requests for the storefront team every day.
- Fixed WCAG colour contrast and keyboard issues found in an accessibility audit.

Software Engineer, Deccan Web Solutions, Bengaluru (2015 - 2018)
- Built jQuery and Angular pages for a travel booking site.

EDUCATION

SKILLS
React, TypeScript, Next.js, Redux, Jest, Storybook
